pack.description: the STK2 Bar's shooting gallery (2011-12 bar_shooting_gallery: its lower level, the gallery's lanes, targets, camouflage nets, bottle shelf and lamps) as a 0.26g lobby project, projects/lobby_scene/stk2_range, lit by STK2's own lights, sun and post-process; @2: the floor at the characters' feet (0.038 m up), the planks under the squad's right member left out, the stock workbench_02 in the back left corner with the weapon 0.40 m above it, camera boxes over the floor and the workbench; @3 (made, not shipped): relit warm (a box probe of the hall, warm fills along it and at the gallery's sides, STK2's halogen work lamps restored, the gallery's hot spot softened, a warm bounce on the character's back), the canister off the vent stack by the workbench (the upgrade table's flight) and a camera box over the bottle shelf; @4: the textures at their STK2 sources' full size (to 2048 px: up to @3 they were scaled to 512 px, the props' to 256); the merged model new with each version (level/stk2_bar/main_v4); lit the bomb shelter's way: no light casts a shadow (the gallery's spot, the hall's ceiling lamps and the halogen lamps cast them), the halogen lamps warm white (they were blue-white), the hall's three ceiling lamps warm and reaching 14 m (19.6: they lit the hall flat), STK2's blue sun left out (unshadowed, it tinted the whole room blue), the room probe's ambient 0.45 (0.2); a camera box under the hall's ceiling (the eye stopped on it at the wheel's far end and saw into the level above) and one over the carton boxes and shelf by the right wall; @5 (made, not shipped): the squad at the firing line (the owner: at the lanes' head they looked 'set there to be shot at'): the character on the shooters' plank floor by the stairs (STK2 (82.0, -3.109, -1.0)), the default view south-east along the sandbag wall and firing counter, the lanes and targets 18 m off to the left (chosen of three: straight downrange, north-east from the lounge, this one); the workbench left out, the weapon of an upgrade window 0.41 m above the firing counter, seen downrange (weapon_view 0.668); camera boxes re-made for the spot (the floor, under the ceiling, the sandbags and counter, the ammunition boxes, the back and south walls with the stairs' doorway, the television table, the chair); a dim warm fill at the foot of the stairs; the merged model level/stk2_bar/main_v5; @6: the owner's pick of the three spots (2026-11-01: 'r1 is good'): the character on the shooters' plank floor with the squad's backs to the sandbag wall and firing counter (STK2 (82.0, -3.109, 0.2)), the default view straight downrange (+x) over the counter, the lanes, the hall's lamps over them and the targets 18 m beyond; the weapon of an upgrade window 0.41 m above the firing counter behind the character's left, seen downrange (weapon_view 0); camera boxes for the spot (the floor, under the ceiling, the sandbags and counter to 0.2 m over its top, the ammunition boxes, the back and south walls with the stairs' doorway, the television table, the chair); the fill at the foot of the stairs kept; the merged model level/stk2_range/main_v1 (made as lobby-stk2-bar@1..6, projects/lobby_scene/stk2_bar, @6 the owner's R1 = this @1; renamed before release, when the owner named the upper floor the Bar); @2: drawn from a path-traced bake in the hybrid way (resource-porter scripts/lobby-bake --hybrid, Blender Cycles on the GPU: the surfaces' albedo, roughness and specular laid out on unique pages lit live by the lamps, their bounce light traced and emitted), the main lamps casting shadows (the three pendants over the counter, the gallery's spot, the wall lamps), the three pendants over the counter white (4000 K, the white point: 5200 K read blue) and every other lamp warm at 2700 K, seen against a 4000 K white point, a fill on the characters and one on their backs (the owner's pick of the hybrid's two looks; seen from behind, toward the dark back wall, their backs were black), the pendants at 0.6 of their STK2 intensity (5, 6, 5: their white smeared the planks before the camera) (the owner: "halogens can be white, hall lamps can be yellow", the pendants being the halogens), the pages emitted on a black unshiny material; the room probe as before (the traced one left the characters' shaded sides near black); the counter under the upgrade window's weapon left unbaked (lit by the engine, its own textures: the baked page blurred the close-up's grain); the fills that stood in for a bounce left out (character_fill, hall_fill_0, hall_fill_1, hall_fill_2, hall_side_fill, gallery_fill, gallery_bounce, stairs_fill)

moves.what: canister_green_low(2), off the vent stack beside the workbench (in the upgrade table flight's way) onto the floor by its twin

camera_boxes.what: under the ceiling (2.97 m over the plank floor)
the sandbags and the firing counter, behind the squad (0.2 m over its top, so the eye stops before it, not on it)
the green ammunition boxes right of the squad, by the stairs
the shooters' back wall (its collision has no margin)
the south wall and the stairs' doorway, right of the squad
